column3: NASB renders “expressly states” as “explicitly says,” “depart” as “fall away,” and “teachings” as “doctrines.”
NASB renders “speakers of lies” as “liars” and adds “as with a branding iron.”
NASB adds “men who” and “advocate,” and renders “for reception with thanksgiving” as “to be gratefully shared in” and “the faithful” as “those who believe.”
NASB renders “every creature” as “everything created” and adds “if it is.”
NASB renders “laying before” as “pointing out” and “good teaching” as “sound doctrine,” and adds “constantly.”
NASB renders “profane and silly fables” as “worldly fables fit only for old women,” “refuse” as “have nothing to do with,” and “train” as “discipline.”
NASB restructures the verse; “exercise” is rendered “discipline,” and it adds “since.”
NASB follows the critical text (“strive”) without “also”; “we have hope on” is rendered “we have fixed our hope on.”
NASB follows the critical text without “in spirit”; “despise” is rendered “look down on,” and it reorders the verse.
NASB renders “gift” as “spiritual gift,” “prophecy” as “prophetic utterance,” and “the elderhood” as “the presbytery.”
NASB follows the critical text without “in”; “ponder” is rendered “Take pains with.”
NASB renders “you will save” as “you will insure salvation.”
